Package nz.ac.wgtn.swen225.lc.domain.entities

Interface Entity

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractEntity, BitFlipper, Bug, Enemy, FireBoots, Flippers, IceBoots, Item, Key, MoveableBlock, MoveableEntity, Player, SuctionBoots, Treasure
public interface Entity
Basic interface that all entities in the game must implement.

This interface provides methods for managing entities' state, location, and game ticks.
